name: Palkia
description: This Pokémon is feared as a deity in Hisuian legend. The birth of Palkia was what caused the walls of our world to disappear, creating a sky that spans for infinity.

moves.name: Twister
moves.description: The user whips up a vicious tornado to tear at the target.

moves.name: Ancient Power
moves.description: The user attacks with a primeval power. This may also raise the user's offensive and defensive stats.

moves.name: Slash
moves.description: The target is attacked with a slash of claws or blades. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

moves.name: Dragon Claw
moves.description: The user slashes the target with huge, sharp claws. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

moves.name: Power Gem
moves.description: The user attacks with a ray of light that sparkles as if it were made of gemstones.

moves.name: Dragon Pulse
moves.description: The target is attacked with a shock wave generated by the user's gaping mouth. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Earth Power
moves.description: The user makes the ground under the target erupt with power. This may also lower the target's defensive stats.

moves.name: Aqua Tail
moves.description: The user attacks by swinging its tail as if it were a vicious wave in a raging storm.

moves.name: Hydro Pump
moves.description: The target is blasted by a huge volume of water launched under great pressure.

moves.name: Spacial Rend
moves.description: The user tears the target along with the space around it. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
